incidents.name: BEC batchTransfer integer overflow
incidents.lossOther: 2 x 5.79e76 BEC minted from nothing; exchanges halted BEC and the token's market value collapsed
incidents.notes: BecToken.batchTransfer() computed `uint256 amount = uint256(cnt) * _value` without SafeMath, so two receivers with _value = 2^255 overflowed the total to zero and passed the balance check while crediting each receiver 2^255 BEC.

sources.ref: onchain review: BecToken 0xC5d105E63711398aF9bbff092d4B6769C82F793D created 2018-02-09T11:27:42Z by 0x36642d20f2e288f18a9a21b544aa853c594dd312, unrelated to the attack sender 0x09a34e01...; plain non-upgradeable token, no EIP-1967 events, age measured from deployment. No credible realised-USD figure exists (the mint was never fully sold), so lossUsd is left null.
